correctness.rationale: The 25 orthonormal degree-four Hopf modes diagonalize the normalized torus restriction. All nine nonnegative polynomial eigenbranches follow from weighted Jacobi orthogonality and their multiplicities sum to 25. Comparison with U=5t^4 and V=30t(1-t)(2t-1)^2 proves a global bound; a unique crossing tau in (0.42,0.43) saturates it because the remaining sectors have strict exact rational lower bounds. Coordinate symmetry proves exactly two optimizers and the sixfold minimum. Extracted standard-library exact-rational checker validates normalizations and polynomial identities. No numerical extrapolation is used as the proof of globality.

value.rationale: An exact natural optimal observation geometry for the full 25-dimensional quartic eigenspace is a substantive sharp inverse-stability problem. The algebraic radius and sixfold bottleneck identify the unique optimal placements and the extremizing harmonic subspaces, and distinguish these from balanced Clifford tori that lose modes. It is not a routine single-norm computation or an arbitrary finite instance.
